comment: Every KSP2 capture replayed by tools/tests/test_ksp2_replay.py. 'pass' fixtures must meet the comparator thresholds. 'capped' fixtures cannot yet, for the stated reason; their recorded errors are a regression ceiling, not a parity claim.

fixtures.reason: Recorded at about 60 frames per second. At that render rate KSP2 loses rotational energy while coasting (0.7%/s at 1.4 rad/s, angular drag 0); every capture at about 32 frames per second conserves it, and three of them repeat to 0.0011 rad/s and pass. Per-part rigidbodies show no joint flex (mean 0.00007 rad/s spread).
Recorded at about 60 frames per second straight after jumping-flea-repeat, so it starts from that run's 2.9 rad/s tumble with the same render-rate damping.
Recorder 0.1 sampled after Update rather than at live physics intervals; superseded by jumping-flea-interval.

OSE's Stability Assist arrests the pulse 0.03 rad/s differently from KSP2's once it engages (the capture records KSP2's SAS commands for a command-level comparison). KSP2's two SAS runs already differ by 0.07 rad/s before SAS engages.
